description: What aiming, steering, text in the world, beams, trails, emitters on things, looks, collision sides, a buffered jump and keeping apart say (PLAN_GAMES_3.md, Phase 2)

examples.intent: Shots aimed at the pointer, that bounce off the walls

input.natural_language: A top-down shooter: the hero shoots where the mouse points; a shot glances off the walls of the room, leaving a streak

examples.intent: A ship that turns and thrusts, and shots the way it drifts

input.natural_language: An Asteroids ship: left and right turn it, up pushes it the way it points, it drifts and comes round the screen; jump shoots the way it is moving

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="rocks" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:prefab name="Shot" tag="shot" sheet="tiles" frame="151" hitbox="4x4" ai="fly" speed="260" lifetime="50" />
  <qg:prefab name="Rock" tag="rock" sheet="tiles" frame="152" hitbox="16x16" ai="wander" speed="25" health="3">
    <qg:on-collision with="shot"><qg:damage target="me" /><qg:destroy target="other" /></qg:on-collision>
  </qg:prefab>
  <qg:scene name="space" width="320" height="240" background="#05050f">
    <qg:character id="ship" controller="behavior" sheet="tiles" frame="150" x="160" y="120" hitbox="12x12">
      <qg:behavior>
        <qg:steer turn="220" thrust="180" drag="0.4" max="160" heading="-90" />
        <qg:wrap />
      </qg:behavior>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:instance prefab="Rock" x="60" y="60" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Rock" x="260" y="180" />
    <qg:on-input action="jump">
      <q:if condition="{abs(ship.vx) + abs(ship.vy) > 1}">
        <qg:spawn prefab="Shot" at="ship" heading="{ship.vx},{ship.vy}" />
      </q:if>
    </qg:on-input>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: Damage numbers, health over an enemy, a squash, a blink

input.natural_language: An ogre with its health over its head: each hit floats a number up, squashes it for a moment and flashes it red; the hero blinks for a second after being hurt

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="ogre" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <q:set name="hurt_until" value="0" type="number" />
  <qg:prefab name="Ogre" tag="ogre" sheet="people" frame="20" hitbox="20x20" ai="chase" speed="20" sight="200"
             health="6" scale="1.4">
    <qg:label value="{'HP ' + str(me.health)}" dy="-20" size="8" color="#ff9090" />
    <qg:on-damage>
      <qg:emit text="{'-1'}" at="me" dy="-12" color="#ffffff" />
      <qg:tween target="me" property="scale-x" from="1.3" to="1" seconds="0.2" trans="back" />
      <qg:tween target="me" property="scale-y" from="0.7" to="1" seconds="0.2" trans="back" />
      <qg:tween target="me" property="tint" from="#ff6060" to="#ffffff" seconds="0.25" />
    </qg:on-damage>
    <qg:on-death><qg:emit text="WIN" at="me" color="#ffe070" size="12" /></qg:on-death>
  </qg:prefab>
  <qg:scene name="field" width="320" height="240">
    <q:set name="blink" value="false" type="boolean" />
    <!-- hidden every other few ticks while it blinks -->
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="60" y="120" hitbox="14x14" speed="80"
                  attack-action="jump" visible="{not blink or ticks() % 8 < 4}">
      <qg:on-hit with="ogre"><qg:damage target="other" /></qg:on-hit>
      <qg:on-collision with="ogre" cooldown="60">
        <q:set name="blink" value="true" />
        <qg:after seconds="1" name="blink"><q:set name="blink" value="false" /></qg:after>
      </qg:on-collision>
    </qg:character>
    <qg:instance prefab="Ogre" x="240" y="120" />
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>

examples.intent: A laser tower, a torch that burns, depth seen from above

input.natural_language: A tower zaps the nearest bat every second with a blue beam; a torch burns on a post; things lower on the screen are drawn in front, and the bats always over everything

expected_output.quantum_code:
<q:application id="tower" type="game">
  <qg:tileset name="tiles" src="assets/kenney/tilemap_packed.png" tile="18" />
  <qg:spritesheet name="people" src="assets/kenney/tilemap-characters_packed.png" tile="24" />
  <qg:particles name="flame" preset="fire" color="#ff9030" amount="10" />
  <qg:prefab name="Bat" tag="bat" sheet="people" frame="24" hitbox="12x12" ai="wander" speed="40" health="2" layer="5" />
  <qg:prefab name="Torch" tag="torch" sheet="tiles" frame="62" hitbox="8x16" solid="true" particles="flame" />
  <qg:prefab name="Tower" tag="tower" sheet="tiles" frame="63" hitbox="16x16" solid="true" />
  <qg:scene name="yard" width="320" height="240" y-sort="true">
    <qg:character id="hero" controller="topdown" sheet="people" frame="0" x="60" y="200" hitbox="14x14" speed="80" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Tower" name="tower" x="160" y="120" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Torch" x="100" y="100" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Bat" x="200" y="60" />
    <qg:instance prefab="Bat" x="80" y="40" />
    <qg:timer every="60">
      <q:set name="near" value="{nearest(tower, 'bat')}" />
      <q:if condition="{near != null and distance(tower, near) < 120}">
        <qg:beam from="tower" to="near" seconds="0.2" color="#80d0ff" width="2" />
        <qg:damage target="near" />
      </q:if>
    </qg:timer>
  </qg:scene>
</q:application>
